source: Shazeer et al. (2017) turned ZXNAME0000XZ into a general-purpose neural-network component with potentially thousands of feed-forward experts and a trainable sparse gate. Only a handful of experts were evaluated for each input. Their language models placed the ZXNAME0001XZ between recurrent layers rather than inside a Transformer.
